description: This file contains unit tests for the ImpactData model in the Goteo project, verifying CRUD operations, validation, and list retrieval functionalities.

classes.name: ImpactDataTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for ImpactData model, testing methods such as create, validate, get, delete, and list functionalities.

methods.name: testInstance
methods.description: Tests instantiation of ImpactData object and setup of database cache.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Creates a new ImpactData object, saves it, and verifies its persistence.

methods.name: testGetImpactData
methods.description: Retrieves ImpactData by ID and verifies data consistency.

methods.name: testNonExisting
methods.description: Ensures fetching non-existent ImpactData throws ModelNotFoundException.

methods.name: testList
methods.description: Verifies that getList returns the expected number of ImpactData entries.

methods.name: testGetListBySource
methods.description: Tests retrieving ImpactData filtered by source.

methods.name: testGetListByType
methods.description: Tests retrieving ImpactData filtered by type.

methods.name: testRemove
methods.description: Deletes ImpactData entry and verifies list count decrements.

methods.name: tearDownAfterClass
methods.description: Cleans up test ImpactData entries from database after all tests.
